targetReport.title: Wskaźnik cen towarów i usług konsumpcyjnych / Zharmonizowany wskaźnik cen konsumpcyjnych (HICP) — Consumer Price Index / Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices
targetReport.description: GUS's monthly price release, covering both the national CPI and the harmonised HICP. GUS's own press-release page states prices are recorded once a month ("Ceny towarów i usług notowane są raz w miesiącu") and that the national index's weights come from the household survey: "Wagi pochodzą z Badania Budżetów Gospodarstw Domowych (BBGD) – cyklicznego badania ankietowego mierzącego wydatki i dochody ok. 37 tys. gospodarstw domowych." Eurostat's Poland national reference metadata separates the two weighting systems: "The main source of HICP weights are National Accounts while the system of weight for CPI is based on data from Household Budget Survey."
targetReport.cadence_note: GUS's press-release page states prices are recorded monthly; Eurostat's Poland HICP metadata confirms the full set is "published each month according to a pre-announced schedule, usually between 15 and 18 days after the end of the reference month."

There are annual meetings of all the consumer price survey staff to verify the sample for the upcoming year and discuss current issues. Tasks on the CENTRAL LEVEL (Consumer Prices Section within the Trade and Services Department): 
 
 
 initiating and establishing methodological rules and assumptions for the organisation of the survey
 
 carrying out development works in order to adjust the methodology to European/international recommendations
 
 monitoring the survey at particular implementation stages and carrying out the final control of the price quotations that have been inspected and approved by the Price Statistics Centre
 
 conducting analytical work and presenting the result
 
 processing transaction data from data providers (scanner data, web data, insurances)
 
 calculating and publishing the results for Poland (CPI, HICP/HICP-CT, OOH)
 
 transmitting data to Eurostat via Programming, Coordination of Statistical Surveys and Registers Department (several datasets within the HICP and REALEST domains: weights, indices and information (HICP-AP and metadata))
 
 
 
 
 Tasks on the REGIONAL LEVEL 
 
 Price Statistics Centre of the Statistical Office in Opole: 
 
 
 gathering data from 16 regional statistical offices (estimating prices, should such a need arise)
 
 supervising the accuracy and the reliability o f the quotations
 
 performing central price quotations (Internet prices, prices uniform throughout the country, cars prices, electricity and gas prices, pharmaceuticals, including reimbursed).

targetReport.title: National accounts (ESA 2010)
targetReport.description: Finnish national accounts produced according to the definitions and guidelines of ESA 2010.

release_schedule.rule: Starting from May 2026, national accounts (annual, quarterly, and quarterly sector accounts combined into one set of statistics) are released eight times a year: quarterly national accounts data are released within two months after the end of the quarter (i.e. in February, May, August and November), and quarterly sector accounts data follow approximately two weeks later (March, June, September and December). Final annual figures are completed in December once supply and use tables are finalised.
release_schedule.note: Confirmed publication cadence via Statistics Finland's own documentation page (dokumentaatio/ntp) and by cross-checking actual past releases: Q4 2025 data released 27 Feb 2026, Q1 2026 data released 29 May 2026 (both ~2 months after quarter end), consistent with the stated rule. Exact day-of-release for the Aug/Sep 2026 editions was not published as a fixed date on the site (release calendar section is JS-rendered and not readable via fetch), so entries use month precision.

release_schedule.note: CyStat's 'Quarterly National Accounts' release (the ESA2010-based national accounts announcement) appears in CyStat's official Release Calendar (Oct 2025-Dec 2026, last updated 07/08/2026), which is refreshed every Friday. Past pattern confirms 4 releases/year, roughly ~3 months after quarter-end: Q3 2025 released 2025-12-01, Q4 2025 released 2026-03-02, Q1 2026 released 2026-06-02, and upcoming Q2 2026 scheduled 2026-09-01 (status 'Preliminary' at time of check, i.e. not yet finalized to a 'Confirmed' date but on the published calendar) and Q3 2026 scheduled 2026-12-01. Separately, CyStat also issues a faster 'GDP Growth Rate (Flash Estimate)' ~6-8 weeks after quarter-end (e.g. next one confirmed for 2026-08-14, covering Q2 2026) which is a related but distinct announcement from the full Quarterly National Accounts release.

results.window: The weights at 5-digit level are price updated, every January to the previous December. The usual sources of the expenditure data used for the calculation of the weights of HICP items are mainly the NA and HBS data. The NA figures are estimates of the households’ consumption expenditures two years old and give information up to 5-digit level, and HBS provides information, no more than 7 years old, about the households' consumption expenditures and gives information at item level.

targetReport.title: Monetary and Financial Statistics Manual and Compilation Guide (2016)
targetReport.description: The IMF's 2016 manual (successor to the 2000 Monetary and Financial Statistics Manual) setting the international methodological standard for compiling monetary and financial statistics — the monetary base, monetary aggregates, and the monetary-authority survey of assets and liabilities. Brazil's Banco Central do Brasil describes it, in its own words, as "referência metodológica de melhores práticas para a produção de estatísticas monetárias e financeiras" (methodological reference of best practices for producing monetary and financial statistics), citing "o padrão definido no Manual de Estatísticas Monetárias e Financeiras e Guia de Compilação (MEMF), edição 2016, do Fundo Monetário Internacional (FMI)" for its "crédito ampliado" statistic.

results.bestSpan: Los cambios toman como base los lineamientos que al respecto el Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) puso a disposicion del publico en marzo de 2016 en su nuevo Manual de Estadisticas Monetarias y Financieras (MEMF).
results.window:
Introducción
• Como parte de los esfuerzos recurrentes que realiza el Banco de México por contar con mejores
      estadísticas –que además se adhieran a los más rigurosos estándares internacionales–, a partir del
      31 de enero de 2018 se puso a disposición del público la estadística de agregados monetarios y
      actividad financiera con base en una nueva metodología. Destacan los siguientes cambios:
         Agregados monetarios: Se mejora la precisión en su medición, se incorpora una mayor disponibilidad de
          información de instrumentos financieros que se utilizan como dinero en sentido amplio y se reclasifican
          algunos instrumentos que no fungen como dinero en sentido amplio.1/ Los cambios toman como base los
          lineamientos que al respecto el Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) puso a disposición del público en marzo
          de 2016 en su nuevo Manual de Estadísticas Monetarias y Financieras (MEMF).2/
         Activos financieros internos: Se define un nuevo conjunto de indicadores que incluyen, además de los
          instrumentos financieros contenidos en los nuevos agregados monetarios, otros activos emitidos en México
          que representan una proporción importante de la riqueza financiera de los sectores tenedores de dinero,
          como las cuentas de pensiones en las Siefores o la tenencia de acciones bursátiles.  Financiamiento bancario: Se revisa la estadística para considerar las operaciones de reporto de valores bajo
          su definición económica en lugar de su definición legal, lo cual es congruente con los criterios contables de la
          Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores (CNBV), así como con las pautas metodológicas señaladas en el
          MEMF.
